description:
Owner-only decision gate. After cutover BenchBox pins Theseus by a reviewed lock. A promotion PR (lock bump) must be refused by oracle-gate unless a record proves the upstream source delta was reviewed. The refusal sits beside the existing omp-bump refusal (_project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py decide(), evaluated before stand-ins) and may read only what the gate already reads: PR files, comments, reviews and statuses. No Actions-artifact read and no new App permission.

Options:
(i) An attester evidence comment bound to the head, as omp bumps use (_project/scripts/omp_bump_gate.py). Cost: one owner action per promotion; oracle source changes about nine times a day today.
(ii) A field in the oracle's own review or status for that head, written only when the promotion evidence check passed.

Either way no existing marker or status changes meaning without a versioned compatibility test.

Guardrails: agents must not choose; record only the owner's answer.
